claims: Riley Green makes his acting debut in Marshals.
Riley Green appears in Season 1, Episode 8 of Marshals.
Season 1, Episode 8 of Marshals is titled "Blowback".
Season 1, Episode 8 "Blowback" of Marshals premiered on CBS on April 19, 2026.
Riley Green plays Garrett in Marshals.
Garrett is a former Navy SEAL.
Garrett is an old teammate of Kayce Dutton.
Garrett arrives with a troubled past to seek help.
Garrett has a complicated history with Kayce.
Garrett has a complicated history with Cal.
Riley Green is a country star known for "Ain't My Last Rodeo."
Riley Green is close friends with Luke Grimes.
Riley Green's friendship with Luke Grimes helped facilitate Riley Green's role in Marshals.
